song.name: The Last Stronghold
song.plot: The resistance's last refuge — a hidden haven in Nythoria where the survivors of the war hold against the Legion. Anya finds a people and a cause; the war closes in around the stronghold. Sets up the final battles before the fall.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: the resistance / survivors ("we"), with the stronghold as a beacon. A haven still standing against the Legion's tide in Nythoria. Placed after Learning to Fly / Mystic Horizon (Anya has met Elara, trained with Seraphina) and before Shadows and Stardust (the Tablets). Anchors: the Legion of Souls, Nythoria, the resistance, a hidden stronghold of the faithful, the war closing in, the fading light. No Rift, no Vorgos acting, no Anya's Rift origin retold here, no civil-war founding, no "Queen". Structure: Verse → Chorus → Verse → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus. Mid-tempo, defiant, slightly desperate. Suggested Suno direction: anthem with weight — warm shared vocals, a beating war-drum heart, strings under rising tension.

section.name: Verse
section.reworked: The Legion sweeps the fevered land, But here, in stone, a fire still stands. A ragged few with weary hands, The last stronghold of Nythoria's strands.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: This is the last stronghold we hold, A keep of hope when the world goes cold. The dark surrounds us, but we are bold, This is the last stronghold.

section.name: Verse
section.reworked: We feed the flame that will not die, We stack the stones against the sky, We hold the line that shadows test, And shelter every soul we keep.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: This is the last stronghold we hold, A keep of hope when the world goes cold. The dark surrounds us, but we are bold, This is the last stronghold.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: When every other gate gives way, And all the evening turns to grey, This is the ground we choose to stay, And light the dark's defeat tomorrow day.
